encodings.note: Sets up a linear address range to be monitored by hardware and activates the monitor. The address range should be a write-back memory caching type. The address is contained in r16/r32/r64. Instruction Operand Encoding1 Op erand 2 Operand 3                  Operand 4 N/A N/A                      N/A
encodings.syntax: UMONITOR r16/r32/r64 Op/En    Tuple    Operand 1 A        N/A      ModRM:r/m (r)

exceptions.when: If the specified segment is not SS and the source register is outside the specified segment limit. If the specified segment register contains a NULL segment selector.
If the specified segment is SS and the source register is outside the SS segment limit. #PF(fault-code) For a page fault.
If CPUID.07H.00H:ECX.WAITPKG[5]=0. If the LOCK prefix is used. Real Address Mode Exceptions
If the specified segment is not SS and the source register is outside of the effective address space from 0 to FFFFH.
If the specified segment is SS and the source register is outside of the effective address space from 0 to FFFFH.
If CPUID.07H.00H:ECX.WAITPKG[5] =0. If the LOCK prefix is used. Virtual 8086 Mode Exceptions Same exceptions as in real address mode; additionally: #PF(fault-code) For a page fault.
Same exceptions as in protected mode.
If the specified segment is not SS and the linear address is in non-canonical form.
If the specified segment is SS and the source register is in non-canonical form. #PF(fault-code) For a page fault.
If CPUID.07H.00H:ECX.WAITPKG[5] =0. If the LOCK prefix is used.
